children: Advancing Toward CE Marking

The digital health company specializing in next-generation biosensor technology said it is actively working with GMED to complete the remaining MDR conformity assessment activities required for its Lumee Oxygen Platform.
Completing these assessments would enable the issuance of the relevant MDR certificate, allowing Profusa to CE mark the Lumee Oxygen Platform.
A CE mark indicates that a product distributed within the 27 EU member states adheres to rigorous safety, health, and environmental protection standards.
Monitoring Tissue Oxygen

Despite the progress made in the conformity assessment, Profusa noted that it cannot guarantee the timing or outcome of GMED’s ongoing evaluations or the exact timeline for the Lumee Oxygen Platform’s CE marking.
